title: Onboarding debriefs + hiring standup log (wk12)
content:
Purpose: capture weekly standup-style notes focused on hiring, interview debriefs, onboarding progress and team health for eng-developer-experience. This is a working doc — action items tracked below.

Meeting cadence: daily 10:30am standup + twice-weekly onboarding sync (Tue/Thu) + interview debriefs ad hoc after panel. Notes from March 9–12 (wk12).

1) Quick wins / announcements
- New hire: welcome Jazmine Kaur (joined 3/09) — backend onboarding plan attached; paired with mentor Ravi for first 2 weeks.
- Hiring panel updated: candidate scorecard template now v2 (link above). Minor wording tweak to 'system design clarity' -> 'service reliability reasoning'.
- Ops: laptop imaging delays — 2 more kits arriving 3/13. Impact: 1 candidate start shifted remote until hardware arrives.

2) Interview debriefs (summary + decisions)
- Candidate A (senior FE engineer) — panel: Maya, Ethan, Sofia. Strengths: component design, observable metrics thinking, good product sense. Concerns: limited infra experience. Score: 7/10. Decision: advance to final onscreen assignment focused on instrumentation and deploy flow. Action: Maya to schedule take-home (due 3/17).
- Candidate B (infra SWE) — panel: Ravi, Ava. Strengths: systems debugging, perf analysis on GPU infra. Concerns: limited async servlets exposure; equivocal on scaling patterns for batched inferencing. Score: 6.5/10. Decision: decline; give feedback emphasizing desire for concrete batch/queueing experience. Action: Ravi to send decline + feedback (by 3/13).
- Candidate C (SWE intern) — panel: Sofia, Maya. Strengths: strong algorithmic foundation, eager to learn. Concern: availability for full-time conversion. Score: 8/10. Decision: extend 12-week internship offer with note about open conversion track. Offer drafted by People Ops.

Notes from debriefs: panels are converging on needing stronger rubric items around 'inference runtime reasoning' (cache/KV behavior, batching). Add explicit question set for next round.

3) Onboarding sync highlights
- Jazmine onboarding plan (week 1):
  - Day 1: HR + infra + intro to console repo + basic runbook.
  - Day 2–3: local dev setup, run small model locally (Mistral-7B trimmed), smoke tests.
  - Week 1 goals: run 'hello-redwood' end-to-end demo, submit first small PR to console docs.
- Mentor pairing: Ravi assigned as primary, Maya as secondary. Scheduled 30-min checkpoints Mon/Wed for first 2 weeks.
- Knowledge transfer: backlog of docs to review before end of week — list pushed to shared onboarding board (ref: ENG-1023).

4) Team health signals
- Bandwidth: multiple interview loops + two ramping hires means feature velocity slightly reduced this sprint. Current ask from product (console breadcrumbs) to reprioritize. Suggest two-week scope trim for console cleanup tasks.
- Burnout flags: one IC reported long weekend spillover to catch up on interviews. Action: leads to rotate interview panels more evenly and limit panel sizes to 3 (instead of 4) where possible.
- Morale: Coffee chat feedback positive about mentoring program; interns report strong clarity on goals.

5) Action items (owners & ETA)
- Maya: prepare inference-runtime-focused interview question set (5–7 focused questions) — ETA 3/15.
- Ravi: send Candidate B decline + feedback — ETA 3/13.
- Ava: finalize Jazmine's first-month learning objectives doc and link into Confluence — ETA 3/14.
- People Ops (Sofia): finalize intern offer for Candidate C and confirm start date — ETA 3/16.
- Ethan: coordinate spare laptop inventory and update hardware tracker sheet — ETA 3/13.
- Team: rotate interview panel schedule to reduce repeated paneling on the same individuals — ongoing.

6) Outstanding / discussion items
- Do we require a separate technical rubric for 'inference infra' candidates (yes/no)? Quick poll: yes. Discussion scheduled Fri 3/13 11am.
- Proposal: 2-week 'onboarding shadow' where new engineers spend 20% time observing SRE/Serving runtime on-call — vote during Thu sync.
- Ask to People Ops: trial expedited laptop imaging for critical hires (2-day SLA) — Sofia to follow up with vendor.

7) Retro notes (what went well / what to improve)
- Went well: faster turnaround on feedback; interview scorecards returned within 48h for 4 of 5 panels.
- Improve: clearer interviewer expectations for take-home tasks; too many ad-hoc homework requests causing candidate confusion. Action: standardize take-home template.

8) Next meeting schedule
- Daily standups continue at 10:30am. Onboarding syncs Tue/Thu 2:00pm. Interview rubric deep-dive Fri 3/13 11:00am.

Quick links: onboarding playbook (Confluence), interview scorecard v2 (repo link), hardware tracker (sheet).

Notes to self (informal): follow up with Maya about pairing Jazmine + intern project ideas; keep an eye on capacity for March demos; remind hiring committee to close out old reqs (ENG-98).

---
Document history: initial notes compiled 2026-03-09, updated with debrief outcomes 2026-03-10 to 03-12.
